prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: professional brand concept board for an internal SaaS email operations product.
Primary request: Create a polished LogiMail logo exploration synchronized with the existing LogiVN brand identity.
Brand context: LogiVN uses deep Vietnamese green #0F4D3A, warm orange #F28C28, ivory #FFF7EB, sage #A9C5A1, rounded app-like mark, friendly geometric wordmark. LogiMail is the internal email platform and AI MailOps dashboard for LogiVN.
Subject: four vector-friendly logo directions for LogiMail: a rounded-square mail shield, a folded envelope with delivery signal, an inbox/ops monogram, and a horizontal lockup with clean wordmark.
Style: premium but practical B2B SaaS, flat vector style, simple geometry, generous white space, crisp edges, readable at small app-icon size, no gradients, no shadows, no photorealism.
Typography direction: geometric sans, stable proportions, exact visible wordmark text only if text appears: LogiMail.
Color constraints: use #0F4D3A as primary, #F28C28 as warm accent, #FFF7EB as background, #A9C5A1 as support, neutral text #2B2B2B. Avoid purple, neon, blue-heavy fintech look, beige-only palettes, visual clutter, tiny unreadable details, stock mockups, watermarks.
Composition: clean brand identity board on ivory background showing the concepts, icon-only variants, horizontal lockup, monochrome dark variant, and small app icon preview.
